rationale: The stock gapped up ~10.5% on an earnings beat but is now consolidating tightly near VWAP ($18.67) with very low-range 1-minute candles and declining volume, suggesting the initial momentum has exhausted without a clear directional continuation. The broader market is under significant stress (SPY -2.31%, VIXY +14.85%), which creates headwinds for sustaining a gap-up in a consumer discretionary name that has already underperformed YTD. With only 57 minutes to close and no clean breakout or breakdown structure to trade against, the risk/reward does not justify entry in either direction.
